items.title: John Ternus's mission: Make Apple more than just an iPhone company
items.summary: Market Catalyst Host Julie Hyman welcomes Maxim Group managing director and senior consumer internet analyst Tom Forte to set the stage for Apple's (AAPL) incoming CEO John Ternus, the challenges that await him, and how much grace period he suspects Ternus will have.

items.title: What Tim Cook told employees on his last day at Apple
items.summary: Tim Cook stepped down as Apple CEO on Monday, leaving parting words to the company's employees who, he wrote, "share a belief that what we build matters."

items.title: Apple new CEO Ternus teases "phenomenal" iPhone launch in first memo

items.title: Why Is Apple Stock Up Today?
items.summary: Apple stock jumped 2.5% Tuesday while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq both fell, and the reason is a name change at the top: John Ternus is officially CEO.

items.title: Who is John Ternus, the new Apple CEO?
items.summary: Starting on September 1, Ternus will lead one of the world's most valuable companies, but if you're not a dedicated Apple enthusiast, you've probably never heard of this man, who has largely remained out of the spotlight until now.
